## In one sentence

> The single claim the speaker was making. If you can't write this line, you
> didn't understand the talk — go back to the abstract before writing the rest.

## Notes

- First substantive point.
- Second. Keep these as claims, not topics: "X doesn't scale past Y" beats
  "discussion of scaling".
- Third.
- Fourth at most. If you have ten, you're transcribing, not noting.

## What I take away

Your own reading — where you agree, where you don't, what it changes for the
kind of work you do. This is the part nobody else can write, and the part
people actually read. Two or three sentences is plenty.

## Open questions

- Something the talk didn't answer and you'd want to ask.

## Links

- [Official abstract]({{< meta abstract-url >}})
- [Slides]({{< meta slides-url >}})
